purpose: Explain the input-mask difference between the OpenVLCLIP v0.7.0 FixRes path and the historical direct Transformers SigLIP 2 CIFAR baseline.

diagnostic.image_selection: first 128 images in official test-set order
diagnostic.comparison: OpenVLCLIP official API vs current direct Transformers adapter with a PAD-derived attention mask vs historical direct adapter behavior without an explicit mask

historical_full_dataset_result.interpretation: Retained as historical context; the input-mask difference means this is not a controlled like-for-like model-quality comparison.

limitations: This is a focused 128-image diagnostic, not a full-dataset benchmark result.
The subset scores do not quantify the full-dataset effect of the mask difference.
No published benchmark measurements were changed.
